signIn.title: Sign In
signIn.subtitle: Enter your email and password to sign in!

resetPassword.title: Reset Password
resetPassword.subtitle: Enter the email linked to your account and we will send you a reset link.
resetPassword.sentMessage: If an account exists for that email, a reset link is on its way.
resetPassword.setSubtitle: Your reset link is valid. Enter a new password to finish.
resetPassword.updatedMessage: Your password has been changed. Continue to the dashboard to sign in with it.
resetPassword.invalidLinkMessage: This link has expired or has already been used. Request a new one.
resetPassword.tooShort: Password must be at least 6 characters.

errors.title: Something went wrong
errors.terms: You must accept the terms to create an account.
errors.emailNotConfirmed: Confirm your email first — open the link we sent you.
errors.userAlreadyRegistered: An account with that email already exists.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment and try again.
errors.samePassword: New password must be different from the current one.

mustChangePassword.title: Choose your own password
mustChangePassword.subtitle: Your account still uses the password an administrator set. Choose your own to continue.
mustChangePassword.subtitleNamed: {name}, your account still uses the password an administrator set. Choose your own to continue.

errors.tooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters.

departments.pageDescription: The departments a profile can belong to
departments.subtitle: The people screen offers these as a dropdown, so a department added here is available immediately when adding or editing an account.
departments.noAccess: This page is only available to administrators.
departments.empty: No departments yet. Add one to be able to place people in it.
departments.deleteBody: {name} will be removed from the list of departments.
departments.deleteInUse: Move everyone out of this department first — deleting it would leave them without one.

errors.load: The department list could not be loaded.
errors.duplicate: A department with that name already exists. Names are case-sensitive, so check the spelling.
errors.create: The department could not be created. Please try again.
errors.delete: The department could not be deleted. Please try again.
errors.inUse: {name} still has {count} person/people in it. Move them to another department first.

users.pageDescription: Review the accounts in this workspace, and add or edit them
users.subtitle: Adding an account sets a first password here, so tell it to the person directly. They will be asked to choose their own the first time they sign in.
users.noAccess: This page is only available to administrators.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, email, or department
users.deleteSelf: You cannot delete the account you are signed in with.
users.deleteOnlyAccount: This is the only account in the workspace. Add another administrator before deleting this one.
users.deleteBody: {name} will be deleted permanently. This cannot be undone.
users.deleteWarningTitle: This also deletes, without any way to recover them:
users.deleteWarningLoans: every loan record for this person, including returned ones
users.deleteWarningLender: the record of which admin lent out each of those assets
users.deleteWarningAssets: nothing — but any asset they were holding goes back to Available with no history of who had it
users.deleteDoneWithLoans: {name} was deleted, along with {count} loan record(s).
users.resetBody: {name} will sign in with the password you set here. Give it to them directly — there is no email to send it to.
users.resetPrompt: They will be asked to choose their own password the first time they sign in.
users.resetFlagFailed: The password for {name} was reset, but their account was not marked as needing a new one. They will not be asked to change it — so pass on the password you set, and expect them to keep it.
users.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. The person signs in with this, so tell it to them.
users.emailManagedElsewhere: The email address is changed in Supabase, not here.
users.lastAdminOnlyAccount: You are the only account here. Add another administrator first — that is the only way to hand over, and it is the reason this is disabled.
users.lastAdmin: This is the only administrator. Promote somebody else first.
users.selfWarning: This is your own account. You will lose access to this page as soon as the change is saved.
users.noDepartmentsYet: No departments yet — add one from the Departement page first.

errors.load: The user list could not be loaded.

errors.saveDetails: The changes could not be saved. Please try again.

errors.lastAdmin: The last administrator cannot be demoted. Promote somebody else first.
errors.partial: The account was created, but its department and role did not save. Close this and edit them from the list.
errors.passwordFlagFailed: The account was created, but it was not marked as needing a new password. That person will not be asked to change it — so pass on the password you set, and expect them to keep it.

assets.pageDescription: The IT asset inventory: what exists, what it is, and where it is.
assets.subtitle: Stock belongs to everyone, so this list is readable by every signed-in user. Only admins can change it.
assets.empty: No assets have been recorded yet.
assets.deleteBody: Delete {name}? Its credential row goes with it. This is refused if the asset is still on loan or has any maintenance record, so that history cannot be lost by accident.

fields.name: Name
fields.isLabeledHint: Whether the physical label has been printed and stuck on the device.
fields.credentialsWarning: Stored as plain text. Readable by admins only, but not encrypted — if that matters, keep the real credential in a password manager and leave these boxes empty.
fields.credentialsHint: Leave both boxes empty to remove the stored credential.
fields.protocolUrlHint: Stored on the asset itself, which every signed-in user can read. Do not put a username or password in this URL — a credential belongs in the Credentials tab.
fields.usageStatusHint: Follows the loans and the maintenance record. Change it from the status control in the list, not here.

errors.save: Could not save the asset. Please try again.
errors.delete: Could not delete the asset. Please try again.
errors.priceInvalid: The purchase price has to be a number.
errors.portsInvalid: Each port count has to be a whole number, or left empty.
errors.duplicateCode: That asset code is already used by another asset.
errors.statusContradictsLoans: That status disagrees with the current loans, so the database refused it. An asset out on loan is Assigned on its own.
errors.inUse: {name} cannot be deleted: it still has {assignments} loan record(s) and {maintenance} maintenance record(s). Returning it and clearing its history is the only way to remove it.
